#define use_crt_defines
#define _ert_No_deprecate

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    while (b) {
        a %= b;
        swap(a, b);
    }
    return a;
}

int main() {
    long long x, y, n;
    scanf("%lld %lld %lld", &x, &y, &n);
    long long best_num = 50, best_den = 1; // initial large error
    long long best_r = 0, best_i = 1;
    long long i = 1;
    while (i <= n) {
        long long prod = x * i;
        long long r = prod / y;
        long long rem = prod % y;
        if (rem > y / 2) {
            r++;
            rem = y - rem;
        }
        long long err_num = rem;
        long long err_den = i * y;
        // compare err_num/err_den < best_num/best_den
        if (err_num * best_den < best_num * err_den) {
            best_num = err_num;
            best_den = err_den;
            best_r = r;
            best_i = i;
        }
        i++;
    }
    printf("%lld/%lld", best_r, best_i);
    return 0;
}

#define use_crt_defines

#include <iostream>
#include <utility>
using namespace std;

long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    while (b) {
        a %= b;
        swap(a, b);
    }
    return a;
}

class Fraction {
public:
    long long num, den;
    Fraction() : num(0), den(1) {}
    Fraction(long long n, long long d) : num(n), den(d) {}
    bool operator<(const Fraction& other) const {
        return num * other.den < other.num * den;
    }
};

int main() {
    long long x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    Fraction best(50, 1);
    pair<long long, long long> result(0, 1);
    for (long long i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        long long prod = x * i;
        long long r = prod / y;
        long long rem = prod % y;
        if (rem > y / 2) {
            ++r;
            rem = y - rem;
        }
        Fraction err(rem, i * y);
        if (err < best) {
            best = err;
            result = {r, i};
        }
    }
    cout << result.first << "/" << result.second;
    return 0;
}
